# SCOPERA

> SCOPERA is the Enterprise AI Platform by ADVANIS AG for companies in Switzerland and DACH: AI agents, workflows, knowledge and governance on one platform, plus consulting to design, build and operate custom AI applications quickly.

SCOPERA is powered by ADVANIS AG, a Swiss consulting firm with over 28 years of experience and more than 300 companies guided. The site is available in German (default) and English; every URL below has a German equivalent at the same path under /de/ instead of /en/.

## Product

- [Product](https://scopera.ai/en/product/): The Enterprise AI Platform — AI Agents, Workflows, Knowledge, Integrations, Analytics, Governance — and case studies of solutions running on it.
- [Packages](https://scopera.ai/en/packages/): Starter, Professional, Enterprise and White-Label packages, plus frequently asked questions about pricing, data location and ownership.
- [Partner](https://scopera.ai/en/partner/): How providers and resellers use SCOPERA to serve their own customers under their own brand (white-label, multi-tenant).

## Services

- [Services](https://scopera.ai/en/services/): Consulting formats that stand on their own without the platform — AI Potential Assessment, AI Readiness Assessment, AI Strategy Workshop, Vibe your Issue.

## Company

- [About](https://scopera.ai/en/about/): Company principles and the team behind SCOPERA.
- [FAQ](https://scopera.ai/en/faq/): Frequently asked questions about pace, licensing, code ownership, data location and more.
- [Contact](https://scopera.ai/en/contact/): Book a call, call us, or send a message.
- [Insights](https://scopera.ai/en/insights/): Articles on AI-native development and what actually works for Swiss companies.
